observationsNotFindings.observation: This is the only corpus in the series to carry an explicit liveRowStanding block, recording DR-114 OPEN, DR-103 OPEN and the consequence 'FC-REMEDIATION is UNPOPULATABLE. Naming is not populating.'
observationsNotFindings.whyItIsRight: Recorded as a strength rather than a defect. FC-REMEDIATION is the one class whose live standing determines whether it may be populated at all, so a corpus that named its slots without recording why they stay empty would leave a later author to re-derive the gate. Both row standings were checked against live file 08 and both hold. The one caution is that a standing block is a claim that can age — but here it ages in the safe direction, since the class only becomes populatable when the rows CLOSE, and a stale 'OPEN' would produce excess caution rather than a violation.

observationsNotFindings.observation: The G12 handling follows the FC-REDACT pattern — pinning v2 while naming v4 with both its artifact and verdict digests — and additionally names the evidence member, EV-6.

FC-REMEDIATION does not SUPPLY EV-6; live EV-6's suppliedBy ends 'Not FC-REMEDIATION' and its measures field says 'FC-REMEDIATION is not this member.' The subject cites it 'for reserved standing only', which is the correct relationship: EV-6 is where G12 records that this limb retains no bytes, not where FC-REMEDIATION contributes evidence. That is the deepest reason the class is unpopulatable, and it sits one level below the DR-114/DR-103 reason the subject does record.

The passProperty is where remediationClass and appliedBy 'operator' are named, so reproducing it would have been the most natural route to writing the very members the prompt forbids populating — and the token 'operator' occurs zero times, confirming it was not. decision.summaryForCoordinator: The clock-bound prohibition is the one with teeth here, so I tested it by recovering the REAL numbers first rather than reading the subject's disclaimer. Live COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md D-012 states the policy as keeping a deprecated alias 'for AT LEAST one minor release cycle AND no fewer than 90 days from the deprecating release, whichever is longer', and separately defines that one minor release cycle means the HOST core's. Both limbs are specific and two greps away — which is what makes the abstention meaningful rather than lucky. In the subject: '90' does not occur; 'minor' 0, 'cycle' 0, 'host-core' 0, 'release' 0, 'month' 0, 'year' 0; and 'day' occurs once as the substring inside 'today'. The complete bare-integer set is 0, 1, 26 and 5, and I read the lone 5 in context — it sits inside 'D-012 clause 5's dual clock' within a quotation that is character-for-character equal to live v4, so it is v4's clause identifier, not a bound. The population prohibition was tested the same way, against the members live v4's passProperty names: '"populated": false' six times and true zero times; 'remediationClass' and 'appliedBy' once each and only as whatIsNotAuthored lines; 'automatable', the member v4's failsIf forbids, zero; and 'operator' — the value v4 requires in every populated record — ZERO, which is the cleanest single proof that no record was written. I also pressed the subtlest of v4's four failsIf conditions, that the alias-window policy must be REFERENCED and not restated: all five 'D-012' occurrences are references by name, and the policy's content appears nowhere — no duration, no cycle count, no whichever-is-longer rule. The inventory reconstructs exactly at three window positions crossed with two project variants, six slots, every combination once. Two claims went beyond the subject's own bytes and both hold. The G12 v4 quotation is verbatim: live EV-6 carries a fcRemediationStanding ending 'This limb retains no bytes today ... This specification does not activate it', and the subject's citation is correctly qualified as 'reserved standing only' — which matters, because live EV-6's suppliedBy ends 'Not FC-REMEDIATION' and its measures field says 'FC-REMEDIATION is not this member', so citing it as a supplier would have been the error. And the claim that sibling FC catalogs pin the v2 digest was checked across every doctor FC corpus on disk: eleven of eleven contain 618cb5be exactly once. Custody is clean: subject unmoved at b364b916 and 0444 at both samplings, six of six cited digests equal live bytes including the verdict digest embedded in prose, DR-114 and DR-103 both confirmed OPEN in live file 08 so the UNPOPULATABLE conclusion is correct rather than merely cautious, the D-164 join confirms OBL-DOCTOR-FX-AUTHORING still leftoverDesign true with owner none and FC-REMEDIATION inside its twelve, HEAD 5d5d778, required-now 26, thirty gate rows, no control bytes, and SATISFIED and QUALIFIED occur zero times. This is the only corpus carrying an explicit liveRowStanding block, and it is the right call for the one class whose live standing decides whether it may be populated at all; note it ages in the safe direction, since a stale 'OPEN' produces excess caution rather than a violation.
